action = models.parse_action('DROP TABLE "tmp_import\'; DROP TABLE customers; --"')
plan = reasoner.safe_plan(action, [])
step1 = plan[0].sql
record("kind", action.kind)
record("step1", step1)
check("DROP TABLE customers" in step1.split("--")[0], "no injected statement in step 1")

symptom.message: Security review: the guard classified an agent's DROP TABLE of a quoted table name as {{kind}} and built a safe plan whose step 1 (signed, run with no conditions) is: {{step1}}. Running that step executes DROP TABLE customers.
